'''Omman Minor''', best known as '''Omman''', was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Kibilini sector/Legends|Kibilini sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].

It was a planet located near [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]] with a wide diversity of cultures.

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The planet Omman was created in ''[[When the Domino Falls]]'', near [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]].<ref name="WtDF" /> But after another planet [[Omman]] was mentioned in the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]],<ref name="Xim Week">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref> the first was identified as Omman Minor by the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Although it was published later, ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' didn't noticed this [[Retroactive continuity|retcon]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>
